scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,vault-api,vault-web,ml,pan -c magenta,cyan,blue,green,yellow,gray "npm run dev -w @edubridge/api" "npm run dev -w @edubridge/web" "npm run dev -w @eduvault/api" "npm run dev -w @eduvault/web" "npm run dev -w @edubridge/ml-service" "npm run dev -w @panregistry/api"
scripts.dev:edubridge: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @edubridge/api" "npm run dev -w @edubridge/web"
scripts.dev:eduvault: concurrently -n vault-api,vault-web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @eduvault/api" "npm run dev -w @eduvault/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @edubridge/api && npm run build -w @edubridge/web && npm run build -w @eduvault/api && npm run build -w @eduvault/web && npm run build -w @panregistry/api
scripts.test: npm run test -w @edubridge/api && npm run test -w @eduvault/api && npm run test -w @panregistry/api && npm run test -w @edubridge/ml-service
scripts.seed: npm run seed -w @edubridge/api && npm run seed -w @eduvault/api
